subject: Re: Kickoff: BERTSeq2Seq for the rewrite features
body:
Priya,

Resourcing:

- Staffing: Tereza 60% (stack + serving), Carmen 40% (modeling), Gustavo 40% (data), Quentin 50% (evals). Holds through 4/20.
- Compute: warm-started fine-tunes are cheap by today's standards - 16-32 titan-a100 GPUs best-effort per run. No reservations needed.
- On budget: Idris has verbally earmarked $120k from the Q3 discretionary compute budget line B-24 for this project, which fully covers the summarization fine-tuning runs and the rewrite-quality human evals. I'll get it in writing when the Q3 cycle opens, but I'm treating it as committed for planning purposes.

One flag: the editor team's rewrite pairs are smaller than DiscoFuse by two orders of magnitude (~45k pairs vs 4.5M). Carmen thinks checkpoint warm-starting is exactly what makes that viable, which is sort of the whole bet.

Deshawn
